checks.description: A unit finishing a damaged objective that cannot shoot it turned on a mobile shooter inside that shooter's own reach. Last fight 13 of the 36 assault losses died on assault.finish-damaged-objective, 11 of them rifles finishing an air-only Nod sam while one bggy killed eight. Absent means the push never stood at a damaged harmless building under fire from mobile units (enemy army dead before the push reached buildings, or no assault at all), not necessarily that the branch is broken.

The concentrate-fire rule is narrowed, not deleted: a damaged objective with nothing shooting the unit, a damaged objective that shoots back, and every siege piece (msam, arty) still finish the building. Last fight 5,115 evaluations. Zero means the new branch swallowed the rule that makes buildings fall.
Returning fire must not turn a base assault into a skirmish that never finishes a building. 22 were destroyed last fight; 8 is the component's reference.
Units that shoot back at what is killing them should not trade worse. valueExchangeRatio was 7.924 last fight (reference 2).

Rifles that return fire on infantry and buggies instead of chipping Concrete should keep scoring kills. e1 killed 47 last fight against an opponent that peaked at 24 units (126 the fight before, against an infantry army).
Fewer rifles spent for nothing at the enemy's buildings should keep mean army at or above the component's reach. 6,543.6 last fight, 3,705.7 the fight before; reference 6,000.

The change is confined to assault targeting in AttackBaseLogic and touches no economy code. Income was 58.7 credits a second (prior median 52.0); below 45 is a regression from somewhere else, or a match lost early.
